n, b = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

differences = []
diffIndex = 0
evenCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
oddCount = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else 0

for i in range(1, n):
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        differences.append(abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        diffIndex += 1
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

differences.sort()

totalSum = 0
count = 0
for diff in differences:
    if diff + totalSum <= b:
        count += 1
        totalSum += diff

print(count)
